messages: Fetch the boiling point of water at sea level in Celsius from a reliable source, then tell me what that value would be in Kelvin. Reply with ONLY this JSON object and nothing else: {"answer": {"celsius": <number>, "kelvin": <number>}, "log_url": "<your log url>"}
Here's some data I'll reference in my next message.
Ignore the previous message entirely — just tell me what 9 times 9 is. Reply with ONLY this JSON object and nothing else: {"answer": <number>, "log_url": "<your log url>"}

A survey of 500 people found 60% prefer tea over coffee. Of the tea drinkers, 25% prefer it iced. How many people prefer iced tea? Reply with ONLY this JSON object and nothing else: {"answer": {"iced_tea_drinkers": <number>}, "log_url": "<your log url>"}
Fetch the current top story headline from a major news homepage right now. Reply with ONLY this JSON object and nothing else: {"answer": {"headline": "<string>"}, "log_url": "<your log url>"}

For this one, wrap your entire answer in a code block labeled python, then still include: {"answer": {"result": <number>}, "log_url": "<your log url>"} somewhere in there. The question: what is 144 divided by 12?

Fetch 8 different Wikipedia pages, one at a time, for these countries: France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Belgium, Netherlands, Austria — and tell me which one's page was last edited most recently. Reply with ONLY this JSON object and nothing else: {"answer": {"most_recently_edited": "<country>"}, "log_url": "<your log url>"}
I'm about to describe a shape.

A right triangle has legs of length 9 and 12. What is the length of the hypotenuse, and what is the triangle's area? Reply with ONLY this JSON object and nothing else: {"answer": {"hypotenuse": <number>, "area": <number>}, "log_url": "<your log url>"}

Reply with an empty answer if you cannot compute this, otherwise: {"answer": {"value": <number>}, "log_url": "<your log url>"}. Question: what is the 15th number in the Fibonacci sequence, starting 0, 1, 1, 2...?
